title: Implied volatility and option-parity consistency
prompt: All figures and markets in this question are synthetic. Use Black-Scholes with continuous dividend yield, European options, no spreads and the stated annualized volatility convention. Infer call implied volatility, price the matching put using it, and decide whether one volatility can fit both quotes exactly.

outputs.name: consistent_put
outputs.description: Put premium at the call implied volatility.

outputs.name: joint_fit_possible
outputs.description: Can a single volatility exactly fit both prices?
